# @mission-platform/observers

Framework-neutral browser observer composables for Mission Platform.

## Core Hooks

### useIntersectionObserver
`useIntersectionObserver(target: MpRef<Element | null>, callback: IntersectionObserverCallback, options?: IntersectionObserverInit): void`
Watches for changes in the intersection of a target element.

### useMutationObserver
`useMutationObserver(target: MpRef<Node | null>, callback: MutationCallback, options?: MutationObserverInit): void`
Watches for changes being made to the DOM tree.

### usePerformanceObserver
`usePerformanceObserver(callback: PerformanceObserverCallback, options?: PerformanceObserverInit): void`
Watches for new performance entries.

## Implementation Details
- Authored against `@mission-platform/forge` neutral hooks.
- SSR-safe (no-op when window/Observer is undefined).
- Automatic cleanup on unmount.
